'''Dasken Hobiv''' was a military virtuoso who analyzed various aspects of war, including logistics, troop movement and organization, and weapon systems. He sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] at the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
